scope: Required source references and acceptance obligations, not generated edges or executed scenarios

families.expectation: Resolve packaged artifact and OS path before connecting launcher to backend entry; preserve wsPort argument origin
families.negative: Unrelated executable with the same basename must remain separate
families.runtime: Record parent/child process identities, arguments, backend readiness and successful request

families.expectation: Terminate/wait/kill refer to the owned process handle, with timeout fallback
families.negative: Two server instances must not release each other's process
families.runtime: Observe normal termination and forced-kill fallback with no retained child

families.expectation: Follow selected server host/port through backend_ws_uri and startup configuration
families.negative: Same path or port in another service/deployment is not a unique target
families.runtime: Correlate client socket, proxy-selected server and accepting backend instance

families.expectation: Application, runner, site and route handler belong to one configured listener
families.negative: Another Application with an identical route must not share handlers
families.runtime: Verify listener address and HTTP/WebSocket dispatch under the selected proxy configuration

families.expectation: Preserve client-to-backend payload forwarding and text/binary branch conditions
families.negative: Reverse-direction forwarding and two simultaneous pairs must retain distinct identities
families.runtime: Use distinguishable payloads in both directions and assert pair isolation

families.expectation: Track assignment and adoption of message callbacks on the same socket instance
families.negative: A callback registered on a different socket is not executed by this receive event
families.runtime: Record socket/request identity and actual callback/response adoption

families.expectation: Expose outgoing and incoming window endpoints with host channel, origin and runtime-mode conditions; establish actual pairing only from its scope
families.negative: Same message name in another window/origin is not an unconditional connection
families.runtime: Exercise embedded host and native WebSocket modes with window/channel identity

families.expectation: Resolve worker URL relative to the creator and build entry, then connect message schemas
families.negative: A sibling worker with the same message type is not this worker's target
families.runtime: Observe creation, request/result identity, replacement and terminate/cleanup

families.expectation: Connect dispatch branch, generation identity and output producer within the selected worker
families.negative: A stale generation's result must not become current state
families.runtime: Assert normal, late-result, cancellation/replacement and resource-release behavior

families.expectation: Relate WebView resource URL and selected port to packaged frontend/backend artifacts
families.negative: Development HTTP URL and release resource URL keep distinct conditions
families.runtime: Verify actual frontend load and a backend request from the selected OS/build mode

families.expectation: Resolve key constant, owning handler map and constructed handler type before connecting dispatch
families.negative: Same key in a different registry does not share targets
families.runtime: Record selected registry/handler and a distinguishable response

families.expectation: Represent registration/callback and matching removal with emitter and callback identity
families.negative: Same event on another emitter or another callback cannot remove this subscription
families.runtime: Assert one delivery before removal and no delivery after teardown

families.expectation: Expose read/write resource expressions; connect only when path value and lifecycle establish the same artifact
families.negative: Equal basename under different directories does not identify a shared resource
families.runtime: Use an isolated known input/output artifact, check content and cleanup independently

families.expectation: Connect database instance/path, device-selected table and creation/insert/query operations
families.negative: Same table name in another database or device does not merge ownership
families.runtime: Import a public fixture and assert schema, row values and device/database isolation

families.expectation: Represent the TS host plugin and Python server-extension registrations, package/configuration and actual API boundaries; membership alone is not a direct call
families.negative: Same plugin id in an inactive/other host configuration does not imply activation
families.runtime: Load the extension in JupyterLab and verify its actual registered handler and frontend interaction

additional_required_interfaces.expectation: Resolve base_url, route list and handler type within one web_app
Follow attached observer instance, event dispatch and pair lifetime; no global method-name matching
Keep missing startup-script generation/packaging target as an explicit unresolved dependency until its build source is established
Report declaration with absent committed target; do not invent a callable or claim this console mode has executed
